name: competitor-analysis
title: Competitor Analysis
description: Compare public competitor websites on structure, messaging, UX, design patterns, offerings and positioning without copying proprietary content.
when_to_use: Positioning or differentiation matters, or the user asks about competitors.
instructions: Summarise patterns and gaps; never reproduce competitor copy, imagery or distinctive designs.
Label each pattern observed (from a fetched source id) or typical_for_sector (general knowledge).
End with concrete differentiation opportunities for this client.
